verdict.rationale: ClickUp's developer portal says it can 'Trigger workflows from ClickUp events' (clickup-docs-3). That is a first-party, developer-facing event-subscription capability, but the pack never explicitly says these are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Slack/Discord notifications, the n8n integration and in-app Automations do not count toward webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit webhook registration endpoint docs, event type catalog, payload/signature details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
